_comment: Canonical village-enemy stat blocks for Defenders of the Realm v2 (Unity port). These are the Hollow Ones that march on Avalon during the wave loop — NOT the ~400-row Heartforge codex registry (data/enemies.json full set lands later). This file holds only the in-village wave roster: the KayKit skeleton archetypes the React v1 stream already tunes. Stats are sourced VERBATIM from the React v1 project src/modules/village/enemies/enemyArchetypes.ts (KAY_ENEMIES + NECROMANCER + ENEMY_DMG_TO_HEART / ENEMY_ATTACK_INTERVAL). The React values already bake in the global ENEMY_HP_BUFF (x2) and ENEMY_DAMAGE_BUFF (+40%), so the numbers here are the final resolved per-enemy stats. moveSpeed is the NavMeshAgent speed (world units/sec). contactDamage is the per-hit damage dealt to a building/wall/gate; attackInterval is the seconds between melee hits.

_sources.portSpec: defenders-unity/docs/v2-unity-port-spec.md (Part 3 enemies row, Part 4 enemies.json schema, Week 4 'Wave 1 = 8 Hollow Walkers')

_schemaNotes.id: Stable enemy id — the wave-data 'type' field keys into this. Also the ENEMY_DEFS bridge key the breach trigger maps to the ATB engine.
_schemaNotes.ai: 'walker' (default — straight march toward the Heart, melee on contact), 'charger' (faster, ignores buildings), 'skirmisher' (fast, picks weakest wall). v2 foundation Wave 1 ships 'walker' only; the others are authored for later waves per port spec Part 3.
_schemaNotes.modelKey: StreamingAssets-independent KayKit mesh key. The Enemy MonoBehaviour / a future Addressables group resolves it to Assets/Models/KayKit/enemies/<key>.glb.
_schemaNotes.hp: Resolved max hit points — includes the React global ENEMY_HP_BUFF (x2). Base minion 26 -> 52, warrior 78 -> 156, rogue 44 -> 88, necromancer 850 -> 1700.
_schemaNotes.moveSpeed: NavMeshAgent.speed in world units/sec. Verbatim from KAY_ENEMIES.speed.
_schemaNotes.contactDamage: Damage one melee hit deals to a building / wall / gate. Regular enemies use the React ENEMY_DMG_TO_HEART value (6); the Necromancer boss uses BOSS_DMG_TO_HEART (17).
_schemaNotes.attackInterval: Seconds between melee hits while in contact. Verbatim from React ENEMY_ATTACK_INTERVAL (1.3).
_schemaNotes.height: Approximate mesh height (world units) — used to size the NavMeshAgent capsule + the floating HP bar offset.
_schemaNotes.boss: true for the Necromancer — leads boss waves (React BOSS_EVERY=6). Carried for catalogue completeness; Wave 1 is non-boss.

enemies.name: Hollow Walker
enemies.flavor: A risen villager of the Hollow Ones — slow, certain, and without memory of the home it marches on.

enemies.name: Hollow Warrior
enemies.flavor: Heavier bone, slower stride. A wall of the dead that the lantern-light barely slows.

enemies.name: Hollow Rogue
enemies.flavor: Quick and low to the ground — it slips the line and goes for the weakest ward.

enemies.name: Alduin's Necromancer
enemies.flavor: A hand of Alduin the Mournful. Where it walks, the Hollowed rise to walk beside it.
